why_agent_cannot: enter an email and click the confirmation link
what_human_must_do: Enter your email and click the confirmation link in your inbox.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Log in with a OneFootball account Sign in on the OneFootball sign-in page , or create an account from there. The FanPass site starts from this login.
2 Step 2 : Create your FanPass Open the FanPass site and create your FanPass with your OneFootball login.
3 Step 3 : Earn XP and grow your FanScore Play, predict and collect, and interact with OneFootball and its partner apps. Each action adds XP and lifts your FanScore.
4 Step 4 : Complete the weekly challenges Take on the weekly challenges and keep up club activity to climb the leaderboard. The homepage ties weekly activity to OFC rewards.
5 Step 5 : Claim your OFC through FanPass Claim the OFC you have earned through FanPass. Start from the OneFootball Club homepage if you want the overview first.
